title: Sort Lines
h1: Sort Lines — Alphabetically, by Length or Reverse
seoTitle: Free Sort Lines Tool — Alphabetize and Order Text Lines
description: Sort the lines of any text alphabetically, reverse alphabetically, by length, or randomly. Remove empty lines optionally. Everything runs in your browser.
intro: Paste a list of lines and sort them in different ways. Useful for cleaning data, organizing lists, or preparing code comments.
blurb: Sort text lines alphabetically, by length, or reverse them instantly.
howItWorks: Paste one item per line into the box.
Choose how you want them sorted and whether to drop blank lines.
Press Sort. The ordered list appears instantly.
examples: Alphabetize a list of names or keywords.
Order CSS class names or file paths by length.
Shuffle lines for a random playlist or test data.

faq.a: Yes. Alphabetical sorting is case-insensitive so 'Apple' and 'apple' group together.
